name: SaaS / B2B services
source: Layout patterns analysed from 3rddegreescreening.com homepage and Small Business solution page (structure only; placeholder copy, library images)

blocks.name: Navbar — mega menu
blocks.desc: Logo, two simple dropdowns, two mega-menu dropdowns, link, text links + button. Mobile menu below 992px.

blocks.name: Header — media background + trust row
blocks.desc: Dark hero over a full-bleed media placeholder (swap for Background Video), two buttons, four trust badges.

blocks.name: Process — numbered steps + image
blocks.desc: Section header, four connected steps, link, tall media placeholder.

blocks.name: Feature — list + floating stats card
blocks.desc: Three features with links beside a media placeholder overlaid by a dashboard-style stats card.

blocks.name: Signup — inline lead magnet
blocks.desc: Centered card with email + button inline form and a supporting link.

blocks.name: Layout — video + text
blocks.desc: Media with play button beside tagline, heading and body.

blocks.name: Feature — checklist + map
blocks.desc: Heading, body, three checkmark benefits beside a map/media placeholder with link.

blocks.name: Layout — centered header, image + icon list
blocks.desc: Centered section header, large image, three icon + text rows and a button.

blocks.name: Testimonial — three cards
blocks.desc: Quote icon, title, quote, avatar initial, name and role. Cards fade up when the section scrolls into view.

ix.note: Cards fade up 24px over 700ms when the section is 10% in view. If the interaction is missing, the cards are simply visible.

blocks.name: Pricing — three plans
blocks.desc: Three plan cards, featured middle plan with badge, feature checklists, full-width buttons.

blocks.name: Logo — infinite marquee
blocks.desc: Heading + continuously scrolling logo row. Pauses on hover, stops for reduced motion.

blocks.name: Feature — 2×2 grid + stats + image
blocks.desc: Four features, four big stats between rules, wide image with caption.

blocks.name: Blog — three cards
blocks.desc: Header with View all, three cards with tag, read time, title, excerpt, author/date. Swap list for a Collection List.

blocks.name: Contact — benefits + form card
blocks.desc: Dark section with heading and checklist beside a white form card (2-column fields, selects, textarea).

blocks.name: Header — split with floating status card
blocks.desc: Tagline, H1, body and two buttons beside a bottom-anchored image with a floating status card; four trust badges in a band below.

blocks.name: Feature — five benefits around a central image
blocks.desc: Centered header; two benefits left, a tall image in the middle, three benefits right. Stacks to two columns, then one.

blocks.name: Stats — four big numbers
blocks.desc: Dark band with four large values, each with a label and supporting detail.

blocks.name: Process — four horizontal steps
blocks.desc: Section header and four numbered steps in a row joined by a line. Steps fade up when the section scrolls into view.

ix.note: If the interaction is missing, the steps are simply visible.

blocks.name: Layout — three alternating image rows
blocks.desc: Centered header and three image/text rows that alternate sides, each with a highlighted takeaway.

blocks.name: Signup — newsletter with image
blocks.desc: Image beside tagline, heading, body and an inline email form.

blocks.name: Footer — brand + five columns
blocks.desc: Logo, description, socials, five link columns, legal row.
